name: ashley-desktop-assistant
description: 丽萨 - local-first personal AI butler
author: GCAI

scripts.build: node scripts/copy-resources.cjs && tsc && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json --noEmit && node scripts/bundle-renderer.cjs
scripts.package:mac: pnpm run build && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac dir && bash scripts/sign-macos.sh release/mac-arm64/Jarvis.app
scripts.package:win: pnpm run build:backend && pnpm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --x64
scripts.package:win:dir: pnpm run build:backend && pnpm run build && electron-builder --win dir --x64
scripts.test: node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings scripts/spoken-hide-test.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings scripts/spoken-music-test.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings scripts/spoken-conflicts-test.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings scripts/runtime-panels-test.mjs

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Jarvis 需要使用麦克风来识别唤醒词。
extendInfo.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: Jarvis 需要控制 macOS 桌面来执行你明确要求的桌面切换。
